Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

delphiPalettes 0.0.0.9000

  • delphi_palette() defaults to "mayfair" and adds direction to reverse the color order.
  • delphi_palette() requires n for type = "continuous".
  • delphi_palette() applies direction before it selects n colors.
  • delphi_palette() keeps alpha values during continuous interpolation.
  • delphi_palette_colorblind() reports the stored color vision result from colorblindcheck.
  • delphi_palettes() adds colorblind_friendly to select palettes with a positive color vision result.
  • print_delphi_palette() draws a selected palette and returns its colors invisibly.
  • print_delphi_palettes() draws palettes as a grid and can filter by category or color vision result.
  • print_delphi_palettes() draws the unfiltered collection on one graphics page per category.
  • The ggplot2 scales map discrete or continuous data to Delphi palette colors. The package loads ggplot2 only when you use a scale.
